data.gender_notes: Valina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Valina is derived from the Latin word 'valere', meaning 'to be strong'. This name was used in the early Christian era and is associated with strength, power, and good health. In Christian tradition, Valina symbolizes the strength and power of the Virgin Mary and her role as the mother of Jesus. The name Valina carries the meaning “Strength, power, health” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Valina usually hope their child will grow to embody strength, power, health and live with faith, good character and purpose.
